{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA test orders
filtered_df = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Check for missing age (age == -1) by channel
missing_age_by_channel = filtered_df[filtered_df['customer_age'] == -1].groupby('channel').size()
print("Missing age (age = -1) by channel:")
print(missing_age_by_channel)

# Check the distribution of customer_segment across channels
segment_by_channel = filtered_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("\nCustomer segment distribution by channel:")
print(segment_by_channel)

# Check conversion rate by channel (before adjusting for segment)
conversion_rate_by_channel = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("\nRaw conversion rate by channel:")
print(conversion_rate_by_channel)

# Check conversion rate by segment within each channel
conversion_rate_by_channel_segment = filtered_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("\nConversion rate by channel and segment:")
print(conversion_rate_by_channel_segment)"}
